plain: The story is about a video filmed in 2013 over the airport at Aguadilla, Puerto Rico. It shows a small, warm object moving low over the area, filmed by a heat-sensing camera. Mick West, a well-known UFO skeptic, brings it up with Michels, setting the scene: 'this is over the airport at Aguadilla, big tourist destination.' West is known for reading such footage as ordinary things seen from an aircraft. In a later episode Michels tells it his own way, offering no ordinary explanation. He calls it 'a 3-minute video of a transmedium object,' meaning one that moves between air and water. In his telling it 'seems to descend into the Atlantic Ocean and then come out as well.' To those who take it as the second kind of thing, it would show a craft that can dive into the sea and leave it again, something no known aircraft does.
